cluster.addNodeHint: The local node is auto-registered by the gpu-agent heartbeat. Adding a remote node goes through a 3-step wizard (node info → environment check → run command); running the command on the target machine completes registration and starts live heartbeats.

cluster.maintDesc: During maintenance the node is removed from service: no offline detection, no alerts, and its GPUs don't count toward scheduling capacity.

cluster.nzCmdHint: The script auto-collects GPU count/names/driver/CUDA/RDMA, registers the node, then starts a background heartbeat (reports every 10s; the platform marks it offline after 90s of silence). Re-run the same command after a reboot to recover.
